beneficiary: MONTREAL.AI scientific and software reviewers, restoring exact executable evidence from the live public release.
previous_constraint: The shipped Activation evidence planner charges each complete archive or pin-bound raw file as a source. It cannot choose exact archive subranges. The published pilot obtained eight exact files at lower payload with eight reads and observed no elapsed-time win.
research_scope: Retrospective adoption of a finding in a subsequently acquired but pre-cutoff scout report. The intervention binds each executable evidence member to a separately pinned trust root. Test separate original evidence, range plan, and scientific outcome checks.
intervention: Use approved ZIP member hashes, source length and exact archive-relative extents from a previously qualified full ZIP. Plan at most two contiguous requests by retaining the largest gap between required spans. Independently verify each extracted member with ZIP structure/CRC and the expected source SHA-256. Perform the actual retained check.
primary: Deliver both independently reviewed exact packets and replay their real checks using no more than two archive body requests and no more than half the cold full-archive body bytes per packet, after index preparation. Claim measured network payload capability for the released alternatives only. Under equal information compare an ordinary interval optimizer and report ties. Reconcile all bytes including index setup and round trips. No elapsed or financial claim follows from the byte gate.
control: Official complete ZIP once plus SHA-256 and same verifier, direct pinned Git member reads with the actual hit count and same required bytes, exact ordinary interval minimization over the same pre-qualified member offsets, and source binding withdrawn negative check. Compare only within each independently identified trust and budget scope.
acceptance: Require both plans minimal, all required member SHA-256s identical to independently pinned source, exact partial HTTP response, correct offset and size with unchanged strong ETag, no duplicate names, no invalid paths, identical real scientific/software check outcomes. Reject failed ranges without publishing recovered results. Test variable and invalid schedule/streams separately if needed.
measurement: Count acquisition bytes, requests, wall and CPU for index setup, run transfers, independent control and verification; distinguish remote handling/unobserved human, total development costs and actual money. Run separated operating cycles and report change from phase pollution and drift.

work.review: Replay the independent evaluated scientific evidence decision packet for two industrial availability decisions and seven abstentions.
Replay the independent conventional SQL check of release-dependency, Atlas and endpoint evidence.

stop: Stop promotion if standards diverge, corpus authority or partial transport fails, both material baseline thresholds fail, or the work cannot be independently reviewed. Retain strong incumbent and negative evidence.
